title: Hero Guard Defense
description: Command heroic castle defenders and stack roguelike skill cards to crush waves of raiding monsters storming your fortress gate.
controls: Tap skill upgrades, build defensive fortifications, and guide your hero to defend the fortress against escalating enemy waves.

zh-CN.title: 英雄守卫战
zh-CN.description: 高燃中世纪城门塔防守卫：指挥英勇骑士与箭塔军团正面迎敌，每波三选一狂叠肉鸽大招守住最后防线！
zh-CN.controls: 点击升级城防与英雄技能，三选一搭配超强肉鸽流派击溃所有进攻波次。
